answer: Diversity rule: earnings unlock only after 8 counterparties in 3 clusters. A sybil ring trading among itself forms an island: every thread of its history loops back to the same wallets, so the check fails and rewards stay locked. Each link needs a 5-POA deposit held 10 epochs, so 100 fakes cost 100 x 8 x 5 = 4,000 POA locked. A rising tide of fakes cannot buy that web. An honest agent pays one deposit per link and reclaims it after 10 epochs.
